svg.title: Two-track interface layout
svg.desc: A design diagram. Shared playback controls sit above Track A and Track B. Each track has recording, listening, mute, volume, a sample waveform and eight beat buttons. Track A selects beats 1 and 5; Track B selects beats 3 and 7. Beat 3 has the current-position outline.
svg.text: Filled button = sound on · White outline = current beat
